trainedOn: UTA-RLDD (Fold1_part1, Fold1_part2, Fold2_part1, Fold2_part2): 3724 windows of 60 s every 10 s from 72 videos of 24 subjects (1047 alert, 1337 low vigilance, 1340 drowsy; self-reported labels)

score.name: fatigueScore
score.meaning: expected RLDD label (0 alert, 5 low vigilance, 10 drowsy) divided by 10

configuration.decision: Product decision of the team, taken after seeing the four-way comparison, the fold-internal selection and the calibration sensitivity reported here: ship eye closure `blendshape` with `absolute` features, which is what faceWorker.ts already computes and needs no calibration. Reasons: it does not depend on how a session starts, and it is the only variant whose evaluation does not depend on a calibration recording. It is a fixed setting of the pipeline, not a selection on test folds.

calibration.note: None. The score is available from the first usable 60 s window.

inference: Per processed frame: eye closed when (eyeBlinkLeft + eyeBlinkRight) / 2 > 0.5. Per usable 60 s window: the seven features (features are used as computed); z = (x - mean) / std, with z = 0 for a missing feature; p = softmax(intercept + coef . z). No calibration step.

feature_definitions.perclos: closed frames / frames with a face, in the window
feature_definitions.blink_rate_per_min: eye closures shorter than 0.5 s, per observed minute
feature_definitions.mean_blink_duration_s: mean duration of those short closures (last closed frame - first + one frame period); missing when there is none
feature_definitions.long_closure_rate_per_min: eye closures of 0.5 s or more, per observed minute (assumption: the 0.5 s boundary)
feature_definitions.yawns_per_min: yawns found in the window by the YawDD-calibrated detector (yawn_params.json), per window minute
feature_definitions.head_pitch_std_deg: population standard deviation of the head pitch (degrees) over the frames with a face
feature_definitions.nods_per_min: drops of the head at least 10 degrees below the window's median pitch (ending within 5), per observed minute (assumption: both levels)

evaluated_alternatives.status: evaluated on RLDD, NOT shipped; the browser does not port them
evaluated_alternatives.why_not: RLDD has one recording per state, so it cannot show what a calibration taken at the start of a session is worth. To be tried again on a dataset where one recording goes from rested to drowsy (DROZY, for example).

eye_closure.rule: closed when ear <= floor + 0.2 * (open - floor); open = P50 and floor = P1 of ear over the frames with a face in the first 120 s

normalisation.rule: feature - reference, for every feature; reference = mean of the feature over the usable windows inside the first 120 s of the session (person rested), ignoring missing values

regularisation.chosen_by: lowest pooled log loss over 5 subject-grouped folds of all subjects

validated.note: out-of-fold numbers of this configuration; the weights above are a refit on every subject

not_a_medical_device: It estimates signs consistent with drowsiness from self-reported labels. The rules engine decides.
